title: My First Game created with AI
author: Altruistic_Idea9478
selftext:
This is my first game created with Opus 4.8 model.   
For game creation process:  
1. My first prompt was described the game mechanism clearly, but I dont import any assets, overall the first out put is acceptable  
2. My next prompt I added some details about the gun, the npc and the environments  
3. The video is the game after 3 prompts, last prompt just upgrade some shooting effects and add the hand, at first it was showed the gun only haha.  
  
Send me some feedback or ideas to update the game would be great. Thank you.

comments.author: Lazy-Department-2518
comments.body: Did u used any game engine with Claude? or is it just the output from claude directly?

replies.author: Altruistic_Idea9478
replies.body: Yes, I use Rezona Lab with Claude, much better and cheaper than from claude directly
